editorialDecl.p: This transcription was produced using the online transcription editor developed by the Center for Digital Humanities at the University of Trier as part of the Workspace for Collaborative Editing Project between 2010 and 2013 and made available for use by the Institute for Textual Scholarship and Electronic Editing and the University of Birmingham.
The XML specifications used are version 1.4 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

div.note: I find it intriguing that most of the places where later chapter divisions were inserted, there are reading lections. Such as here where the end of chapter 4 is indicated by a "τελος" and the beginning of chapter 5 is indicated by an "αρχη".

ab.note: the copyist seems to have made another slip in scribendo, erased the mistake, then continued on.
it looks like the τον in front of ιακωβον and τον in front of ιωαννην were erased.
It is as if the scribe went to write "αυτου" stopped the line mid word at "αυ" went to the next line, then wrote "αυτου" all over again

ab.w:
εIt's as if the scribe began to write ενειλησε started with ε then went to the next line and wrote out ενειλησε in full.
ενειλησε
